items.issue: engines.npm is advisory only - .npmrc has no engine-strict=true and neither CI (setup-node + npm ci) nor the Dockerfile installs npm 11.6.2, so the pin only holds while the Node image happens to bundle it (Node 24.11.1 does today)
items.fix: Add engine-strict=true to .npmrc so an npm/Node drift fails loudly, or install npm@11.6.2 explicitly in CI and the Dockerfile

items.issue: packageManager is set without a Corepack integrity hash, so any Corepack-enabled environment resolves and downloads npm 11.6.2 unverified at first invocation
items.fix: Run 'corepack use npm@11.6.2' to write the hashed form (npm@11.6.2+sha512...), or drop packageManager if only the Dependabot alignment is wanted and engines.npm alone suffices
